sections.basis: Taxable income, per year (simple tax, before the multipliers)
sections.note: Tariff vintage: Tarif 2026, per ESTV Kantonsblatt (Stand Februar 2026).

rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: Married couples, single parents living with children and widowed persons (year of death and two following years): the rate of the whole income divided by 1.9 (§ 44 Abs. 2 StG)

rows.label: Basic tariff: taxable income above CHF 319,900
rows.note: Für Einkommen ab 319'900 Franken beträgt die Steuer 10,50% des gesamten Einkommens.

source.title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Solothurn (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, § 44 Steuergesetz

rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
Communal multiplier: Solothurn (cantonal capital; other communes differ)
Church tax, Reformed (multiple of the simple tax)
Church tax, Roman Catholic (multiple of the simple tax)

source.title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

sections.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Solothurn; other communes in Solothurn set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).

sections.title: Corporate profit tax 2026 (Solothurn)

rows.label: Cantonal multiplier 2026 (profit tax)
rows.value: 100% (including a 10% equalisation tax for the parishes)

sections.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.

sections.title: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Solothurn)

rows.label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer)
rows.value: None: the canton and its municipalities levy no property tax

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)

sections.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).

sections.title: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Solothurn)

rows.label: Reduced rate
rows.value: Half the rate (1.1%) for acquisitions between spouses, registered partners and by descendants

source.title: Solothurn Gesetz über die Staats- und Gemeindesteuern (Steuergesetz, BGS 614.11), Stand 1. Januar 2025, §§ 208 and 212

sections.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
